review:
Wazdan's Christmas game: 20 paylines, festive food and gift symbols, and jackpots hidden inside the presents. Cash Out symbols give instant wins on any spin.

Gift symbols can contain jackpots, and filling the grid with gifts awards the 1,500x Grand. Chance Level doubles the bet to make jackpots inside gifts more likely. Medium-high volatility, 96.12% RTP. An easy-to-follow seasonal pick.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
